Name: Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a resource mod for map modders, adding a new tilesheet containing various buildings. It uses Content Patcher to load the tilesheet in the game, allowing other mods to use it as a [b]dependency[/b].

[u][b]Update : 1.4.0
[/b][/u]
- Added a seasonal giant flower. Art is coming from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598]Lumisteria Serene Meadow[/url] and Visit Mount Vapius (release soon)﻿
- The mod was working fine previously, it is still working fine now!

[u][b]Update : 1.3.0[/b][/u]
- Reeds are included in the decoration tilesheet. There's a winter reeds version and one without them. They have a small animation and optional overlay for water flow.
- An entire seasonal set of tilesheet was added with lot of new tiles, including : [b]grassy water edges[/b], several cliffs options, sandy cliffs, stairs, and a lot of [b]grass-dirt transition[/b]. The winter tilesheet should line up with existing winter tiles! Recolors: Not currently supported.
- See images for example of the new content.

Plenty of options to create new content :) Note : if you use recolors, the new tiles will not be supported, but permissions are open to make recolor patches for my tilesheets.

[u][b]Update : 1.2.0[/b][/u]
Several additions were made to the decoration tilesheet :
- A waterfall. [b]Important note[/b] : Recolors: Not currently supported. The waterfall will work just fine, but may not blend with map colors.
- Foam to go with the waterfall. Both can be animated
- A wood arch with decorative lanterns. They don't emit light.
- Several wood elements, including some ferns, stumps and a stump you can use as a seat.

Have fun !


[u][b]Update : 1.1.0[/b][/u]
Added a tilesheet containing various decoration items. Note that depending of how and where you use them, you may want extra layers or specific placement to avoid front layer "colliding" with head of player. Remember to read the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/891]article [/url]if you want to make edits of the assets, as it lists conditions when it's allowed. Some furniture have empty version so adding your own flowers/decoration would be easier.

[u][b]For players[/b][/u] : this mod does nothing on its own. However, other mods may require it to add new furnitures to their map. If this mod is listed as a dependency for a mod, you need it.

[u][b]For modders[/b][/u] : You can treat the assets of this mod the same way you would do with vanilla assets : use them to create the map, keeping the same name*, but[b] do not include in your mod folder on release, and don't redistribute the assets[/b]. This will cause issues.
Don't forget to add this mod as a dependency.
(*renaming assets in tiled when needed for loading order purpose is fine. Don't change the original name of file however).

If you aren't familiar with the process, ask questions in comments or on the modding section of the SDV discord :)

Important : See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/891]article [/url]adding information about what to do if you want to use an edited version of my assets, and conditions when permissions are granted.
[u]
See also[/u] : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9599]Lumisteria Tilesheet - Indoor[/url] : A tilesheet full of indoor-themed option. You can totally use some of them outside however, especially the plant decoration. They will just not have seasonal options.

[u][b]Notes [/b][/u]:
- Remember that you can flip tiles in tiled (for .tmx), allowing in some case for more options !
- "What about multiple mods using the same building ?". In addition of having a good amount of building, some of them have some variation, allowing for lot of option to make them more unique. Creative mapping also allows to give unique touch. In addition, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/891]article [/url]provide some more option.
- If you use this mod in one of your mod, you are encouraged to put a link in the comments with details about what you use ! Other modders may then know what buildings are used, how, and where :) Submitting images is also encouraged !

[u][b]Example packs :[/b][/u]
There is currently no example pack.

[u][b]Recolors :[/b][/u]
Recolor mod authors are allowed to target the assets of this mod. However making a configuration option so this can be disabled is strongly suggested, in case of new tiles being added and similar situations.

Thanks for your understanding :)

[u][b]Images in gallery :[/b][/u]
All the images of gallery are examples of what the mod can do and aren't (currently) used in any released mod.
